steps.code:
# Fetch all liked songs to build a set of liked song IDs
liked_ids = set()
page = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=login_resp['access_token'], page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not resp:
        break
    for song in resp:
        liked_ids.add(song['song_id'])
    if len(resp) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print(f"Total liked songs: {len(liked_ids)}")
print("Current song 93 liked?", 93 in liked_ids)

# Keep going to previous song until we reach a liked song
access_token = login_resp['access_token']
max_steps = 100
for i in range(max_steps):
    prev = apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Step {i+1}: {prev}")
    if prev.get('song_id') in liked_ids:
        print(f"Reached liked song {prev['song_id']}")
        break
else:
    print("No liked song found in queue after many steps")
